versions.content: The function Dem_SetFreezeFrameRecordFilter shall set the static filter criteria attribute all freeze frame records currently stored in the event memory  to be used for the subsequent calls of Dem_GetNextFilteredRecord and Dem_GetNumberOfFreezeFrameRecords . This filter always belongs to primary memory.
